content.text: Oscars Wiki Main Page Discuss All Pages Community Interactive Maps Recent Blog Posts Overview Films Nominees Songs 2024 2023 2022 2021 2020 2019 Other Years Recent blog posts Forum Special pages Skip to content Main Page Discuss All Pages Community Interactive Maps Recent Blog Posts Overview Films Nominees Songs 2024 2023 2022 2021 2020 2019 Other Years Recent blog posts Forum Special pages Paul Thomas Anderson Paul Thomas Anderson is an American film director, screenwriter, and producer. As of 2013, he has written and directed six feature films: Hard Eight (1996), Boogie Nights (1997), Magnolia (1999), Punch-Drunk Love (2002), There Will Be Blood (2007), and The Master (2012). He has been nominated for fourteen Academy Awards.
